identity:
untitled2047-1803.mp4

The video shows a patio door and some happy meowing can be heard.
"Aww, Muffin, have you slain a leaf or grass hopper again?" a feminine voice asks.  A cat appears in front of the door and drops a crow, dripping with black goo.  "Eww, you shouldn't hunt birds!", she turns around and is visibly nervous.  "Honey, what the hell is that?  Was that poor bird caught in an oil spill?"

identity: This is an inactive Honda Crop King.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground, loading the unit with napalm in your inventory and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully the tribot will then identify you as an ally, roam around or follow you, and impale hostiles with its spiked cable weapons.

Welcome to the Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead tutorial!  As you play, pop-ups like this one will appear to guide you through the basic game actions.

At any time, you can press <keybind:HELP_KEYBINDINGS> to open the <color_light_cyan>Keybindings menu</color> to view or modify the controls for the game or specific menu that you are in.

Pressing <keybind:POPUP_WAIT:QUIT> will close the pop-up.
